Name: Ahio, Driver of the Cart
Summary: Drove the cart bearing the ark from the house of Abinadab.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 13:7: Drove the cart bearing the ark from the house of Abinadab.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ahio in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
